author: __DONNIE__
body:
I have recently been working on a new map for nebula (DTM) called : Ruined Earth


The map itself is meant as a representation of how damaged the earth is, hence all the lava. This is why i created the map with little green area, with the tree in the middle showing the most important area of the map.

The map has two monuments on each team; A and B- With two teams, purple and lime.  Names for these teams has currently been a struggle and any ideas would been appreciated, as i have not completed the YAML yet. the first two teams to destroy both monuments wins.

The map itself has a small iron area, with few diamonds in the middle continuing with various valuable items around the map- containing "spawn horses" and "enchanted diamond armour."
